claims.statement: At least a one-year express warranty covers qualifying assistive-device defects.
claims.scope: Covered consumer transactions and warranty defects
claims.limitations: Individual applicability, definitions and current implementation require case-specific checking.
claims.title: Warranty protection for qualifying defects

claims.statement: Comparable loaner required for qualifying warranty repair when repair exceeds 21 days, or the same defect was returned on three or more previous occasions.
claims.scope: Manufacturer/supplier warranty repair, not every breakdown
claims.limitations: Individual applicability, definitions and current implementation require case-specific checking.

timing.trigger_note: Includes tender day; alternate repeated-defect trigger also applies.

claims.title: Loaners during qualifying warranty repairs

claims.statement: Component repairs may require need verification; wear-item repairs do not. Medicaid does not pay for temporary loaner equipment while a wheelchair is repaired.
claims.scope: Wheelchairs for community users and custom chairs for LTC residents as specified
claims.limitations: Non-custom LTC chairs have a separate facility responsibility rule. Managed-care implementation not reconciled.
claims.title: Medicaid repair and temporary-equipment payment rules

claims.statement: Home modification is listed among Ohio Home Care Waiver services.
claims.scope: Eligible waiver participants; service authorization required
claims.limitations: Individual applicability, definitions and current implementation require case-specific checking.
claims.title: Home modifications through a waiver program

claims.statement: Vehicle modifications are listed among waiver services.
claims.scope: Eligible Ohio Home Care Waiver participants
claims.limitations: Individual applicability, definitions and current implementation require case-specific checking.
claims.title: Vehicle modifications through a waiver program

claims.statement: Community integration and transition are listed waiver services.
claims.scope: Eligible Ohio Home Care Waiver participants
claims.limitations: Individual applicability, definitions and current implementation require case-specific checking.
claims.title: Community integration and transition services

claims.statement: Minimum one-year warranty; qualifying unresolved defects can lead to replacement or refund after a reasonable repair attempt.
claims.scope: New motorized wheelchairs and covered consumers
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Motorized scope; definition of reasonable repair attempt and consumer procedure must be retained. This is not independent parts access.
claims.title: Motorized-wheelchair warranty remedies

claims.statement: One-year minimum wheelchair warranty; reasonable-repair definition includes at least three repair attempts with continuing defect, or at least 30 aggregate days out of service.
claims.scope: New wheelchair warranty nonconformities; definitions/exclusions apply
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Threshold is a remedy trigger, not a universal repair-completion deadline.
claims.title: Wheelchair warranty replacement or refund triggers

claims.statement: MDHHS publishes a wheelchair repair/labor guide and states its provider manual controls policy discrepancies.
claims.scope: Michigan Medicaid provider policy; underlying code-specific rules not yet extracted
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Gateway verified, not a coverage determination; fee schedule, manual and plan rules need review.
claims.title: Where to check Medicaid repair policy

claims.statement: A new assistive device has a minimum one-year warranty under the act.
claims.scope: Covered new devices, including manual/power wheelchairs
claims.limitations: Individual applicability, definitions and current implementation require case-specific checking.
claims.title: Warranty protection for new assistive devices

claims.statement: Comparable substitute device or rental reimbursement is required during qualifying warranty repair exceeding ten working days, or for the same problem after at least two previous repair tenders.
claims.scope: Warranty device tendered to original/exchange dealer; statutory conditions apply
claims.limitations: Individual applicability, definitions and current implementation require case-specific checking.

timing.trigger_note: Includes tender day; alternative repeat-repair trigger exists.

claims.title: Substitute equipment or rental reimbursement

claims.statement: Minimum one-year warranty; qualifying warranty repairs are without parts/labor charge.
claims.scope: New assistive technology with retail price at least $1,000; specified exclusions
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Batteries, nonfunctional accessories and normal recurring maintenance excluded; do not generalize to lower-priced devices.
claims.title: Warranty scope includes a price threshold

claims.statement: Repair-code prior authorization depends on the fee schedule; warranty repairs are not paid by IHCP, and rental repairs are the rental provider’s responsibility.
claims.scope: Indiana Health Coverage Programs DME/HME provider manual
claims.limitations: Manual policy date, not a statute commencement. MCE-specific implementation and code requirements remain open.
claims.title: Repair approval, warranty and rental responsibilities

claims.statement: At least a one-year express warranty is required; specified warranty/remedy limitations are void.
claims.scope: Covered assistive devices/consumers under article definitions
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Definitions and remedy procedures in adjacent sections still need extraction.
claims.title: Assistive-device warranty requirement

claims.statement: STAR+PLUS HCBS adaptive aids include mobility aids and repair/maintenance outside warranty, subject to the individual service plan.
claims.scope: STAR+PLUS HCBS participants; not all Texans
claims.limitations: Older handbook revision; verify current MCO policy and authorization before use.
claims.title: Adaptive aids through STAR+PLUS HCBS

claims.statement: Vehicle modifications are among the described adaptive-aid categories.
claims.scope: STAR+PLUS HCBS service-plan route
claims.limitations: Not a universal vehicle purchase or modification entitlement; current limits and approval remain to verify.
claims.title: Vehicle-adaptation program pathway

claims.statement: Minimum one-year express warranty applies to new covered assistive-technology devices.
claims.scope: Definitions in 427.802 and remedy procedures in 427.804 need accompanying review
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Warranty existence reviewed; device exclusions and remedy deadlines not yet mapped.
claims.title: New assistive-device warranty requirement

claims.statement: Official chaptered summary identifies powered-wheelchair parts, tools and information access on fair/reasonable terms.
claims.scope: Powered wheelchairs; detailed part/clinical exclusions not verified in current code
claims.effective_date_note: Official summary gives a January 1, 2025 product-sale scope date, not separately verified commencement.
claims.limitations: Summary says products sold on/after January 1, 2025. Full code applicability, including in-use equipment and clinical component limits, requires verification.
claims.title: Powered-wheelchair repair access: legislative summary

claims.statement: One-year implied warranty supplements express warranty; qualifying nonconformities are repaired without parts/labor charge, with replacement/refund remedies after reasonable repair attempts.
claims.scope: New covered assistive devices; definitions and exclusions apply
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Normal wear, routine maintenance and unauthorized modifications are among exclusions; downtime rules account for loaner availability.
claims.title: Assistive-device warranty remedies

claims.statement: State text recognizes equal use of public places and transport accommodations, subject to lawful conditions.
claims.scope: People with disabilities; actual mode/provider obligations need further review
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Does not establish a door-to-door ride, a specific rural service level or a wheelchair repair right.
claims.title: State public-place and transportation access text

claims.statement: Enacted summaries establish manufacturer resources for powered-wheelchair repair by owners and independent providers; later digital-equipment expansion preserves the powered-wheelchair distinction.
claims.scope: Powered wheelchair repair; not all medical devices or all mobility aids
claims.limitations: Full current CRS Part 15 and device-specific application must be checked before an enforcement claim.
claims.title: Powered-wheelchair repair access: enacted summaries

claims.statement: Manufacturers must make repair resources available on fair/reasonable terms for covered mobility equipment.
claims.scope: Includes powered/manual wheelchairs, mobility scooters and manual-chair power assists
claims.limitations: Exceptions and manufacturer availability constraints apply; payer coverage and repair completion time are separate questions.
claims.title: Repair-resource access for mobility devices

claims.statement: Manufacturers must provide repair resources on fair/reasonable terms; the act also restricts specified parts-pairing barriers.
claims.scope: Mobility devices including powered/manual wheelchairs, scooters and power assists
claims.limitations: Effective on approval under section 33, not the October date from neighboring bills. Exceptions and civil enforcement procedures require individual review.
claims.title: Repair-resource access and parts-pairing restrictions

claims.statement: Authorized wheelchair dealer must respond within one business day and order parts within three business days after assessment or insurer authorization.
claims.scope: Wheelchairs sold/leased by the dealer; CRT home-repair provision also exists
claims.limitations: Individual applicability, definitions and current implementation require case-specific checking.

timing.trigger_note: Parts-order deadline is separate: three business days after assessment or insurer authorization. No universal three-day completion guarantee.

claims.title: Dealer response and parts-order deadlines

claims.statement: Specified individual/group policies cannot require a new prescription or prior authorization for medically necessary CRT wheelchair repair/replacement unless the original prescription is older than five years.
claims.scope: Specified state-regulated health policies and CRT; not automatically Medicare, self-funded ERISA plans or every payer
claims.limitations: Written medical-necessity determination and policy/device definitions apply. Medicaid section is not fully reconciled here.
claims.title: Approval restrictions for specified insurance policies

claims.statement: Assistive-device nonconformity repair protection uses the express-warranty period or two years after delivery, whichever is longer.
claims.scope: Covered AT devices; excludes batteries/nonessential accessories
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Not the same as a universal two-year manufacturer express warranty; claim reporting and availability conditions apply.
claims.title: Assistive-device defect repair protection

claims.statement: Medicare Part B wheelchair/scooter coverage has medical necessity, examination/prescription and supplier requirements; certain power chairs require prior approval.
claims.scope: Eligible Medicare beneficiaries; original Medicare guidance
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Not a Medicaid, private-insurer or universal repair-access rule; distinguish Medicare Advantage administration.
claims.title: Medicare equipment coverage requirements

claims.statement: FTA accepts public-transit discrimination complaints and encourages contacting the local transit provider first.
claims.scope: Covered public-transit providers and discrimination concerns
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: FTA guidance recommends filing within 180 days; do not substitute a policy letter for a complaint process.
claims.title: Public-transit complaint routes

claims.statement: DOJ describes conditional rights to community integration rather than unnecessary institutional segregation.
claims.scope: State/local disability services; appropriateness, individual wishes and reasonable modification conditions
claims.effective_date_note: Exact commencement date not established in this pass.
claims.limitations: Does not guarantee a specific waiver slot, personal-assistance hours or chosen equipment.
claims.title: Community integration conditions

inferences.statement: Warranty-backed loaners and Medicaid payment restrictions may leave a continuity gap outside the warranty route.
inferences.proposed_next_action: Research who supplies and funds backup mobility outside qualifying warranty cases; ask ODM about an interim-equipment policy.
inferences.limitations: Does not establish that every person lacks a backup option or that a particular denial is unlawful.
